name: Retail receipt rebate offer ad ("buy 2 at Target, upload your receipt, get 1 back")

shots.visual: Hand holding 2 products in a real retail aisle
Three icons left→right: cart, receipt photo, money back
Grabs two, checkout, phone uploading the receipt
shots.audio_text: "and you get one back. Like, free."
"Rebate link in bio / tap Learn More"

prompts.prompt: Write 10 headline variants for a "buy 2 at {{RETAILER}}, get 1 back via receipt upload" offer. ≤8 words each, no exclamation marks, plus a 1-line legal footer.
Meta location targeting: 10-15 mile radius around stores carrying the SKU; exclude existing DTC buyers 30d.

references.author: GustavWalsted
references.note: Primal Queen's live offer page behind the Meta ad. The headline is "BUY ONE GET ONE FREE". How it works: 1) buy any 2 Primal Queen products at your nearest Target; 2) enter your phone number; 3) we text you a link to upload your receipt; 4) once verified we refund via PayPal or Venmo. "That's it. One product is on us." Under that is a "FIND MY CLOSEST target" store locator with a map. Paid social

references.author: eCom_Amin
references.note: primal queen prints $2M a month and their google funnel is the most complete i've dissected all year AI youtube ads with 1M+ views, an advertorial run

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Check the retailer agreement before advertising a rebate.
Avoid: Payout delays kill trust; automate refunds within 7 days.
Avoid: LC is DTC-only today; only use the trade-in variant until it has retail or marketplace presence.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
